login.title: Sign in
login.heading: Antifaz panel
login.intro: Type the administrator token to open the panel.
login.token.label: Administrator token
login.token.help: It is the value of ANTIFAZ_ADMIN_TOKEN in your configuration. The panel stores nothing in your browser; your password manager may offer to save it.
login.error.failed: That token does not open the panel.
login.error.too_many: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
login.error.too_many_later: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a minute.
login.error.refused: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
login.error.network: Antifaz cannot be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
login.note: The session closes by itself after 30 minutes without use.
panel.title: Panel
nav.label: Panel
settings.label: Settings
view.playground.intro: Paste a text with made-up data and see what the AI would receive and what it would give back to you. What you try is not stored.
view.live.intro: What goes through Antifaz right now. Only types and counts: never a value or a marker.
view.keys.intro: One key per team or application: so you know who uses the AI, with which limits and which policy.
view.policies.intro: What Antifaz does with each type of data. Each key uses one policy.
view.status.intro: If a part fails, Antifaz blocks: it never lets unprotected data through.
view.soon: Coming in a later version of the panel.
view.playground.empty: Here you will see your text with the data found, what the AI receives (with markers instead of data) and the answer with your data back.
view.live.empty: Here you will see what goes through Antifaz as it happens: only types and counts.
view.keys.empty: Here you will see your virtual keys: one per team or application, with its limits and its policy.
view.policies.empty: Here you will see what Antifaz does with each type of data, and every revision of the policy.
status.error.title: Could not read the status
status.error.network: Antifaz cannot be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
status.error.refused: The status could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
status.sessions: Panel sessions live in the memory of each process: a restart closes them, and with several processes each one keeps its own.
status.ner.desc: Finds people's names. It comes off by default. Its states:
status.ner.states: Possible states of the name detector
status.ner.off.desc: Not in use: Antifaz still finds the other types of data.
status.ner.starting.desc: Loads the model; meanwhile, what needs it is blocked.
status.ner.circuit_open.desc: Blocks for a few seconds and tries again.
status.ner.closed.desc: Blocks everything that needs the NER.
status.credentials: Its address carries a user name or a password: move them out of the address.
status.foot: This page does not update by itself: press «Refresh» when you need it. It never calls a provider.
sidebar.privacy: Outside «Try a text», the panel never shows personal data: only types and counts.
sidebar.local: Personal data is detected and replaced on your network
logout.error.title: Could not sign out
logout.error.refused: The request was refused. Reload the page and try again.
logout.error.network: Antifaz cannot be reached. Check that it is running and try again.
